item.description:
Added
• In-app updates through Sparkle, with signed downloads, installation, and relaunch. • Menu bar update indicator and a notification shown once per available version. • Settings footer with the running version and a link to the project on GitHub. • Update channel selection: Stable by default, with an opt-in for release candidates.
Changed
• Install replaces the manual Download link, with a compact confirmation and a scrollable changelog when release notes are available. • Raised the minimum MenuBarKit version to 1.2.0. • Release tooling publishes a shared Stable/RC appcast, preserves archive signatures, and rejects reused build numbers. Candidate releases are marked as prereleases. • Shortened the README and moved usage, architecture, development, and release guidance into dedicated documents. • Update checks run silently at launch and every six hours. Manual checks remain available when automatic checks are disabled.
Fixed
• Switching update channels during an active session waits for completion and checks the latest selection without getting stuck on Checking. • Up-to-date checks no longer show a failed result after Sparkle completes the check.
Removed
• Custom GitHub release polling and the outdated Gatekeeper hint in update settings.
